newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sampo proposes four-for-one share split.
newsitem.headline: Sampo proposes four-for-one share split.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo said in a statement on Wednesday it would propose to the annual general meeting a four-for-one share split, cutting the nominal share value to five markka.
"The board of Sampo is proposing ... that the nominal value of shares be reduced from 20 markka to five markka so that four new shares will be created out of each old share," Sampo said.
The board would propose that the reduction of the nominal value of shares takes effect after Sampo has changed over to the book-entry securities system in autumn 1997, it said.
The annual general meeting will be held on April 16. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
